searchText: Point of Order: where is the best place to ask pseudo-social questions like "how many core devs are going to be at the Stanford Blockchain Conference"? I’m not sure the best place, maybe <#823588372743323658> or <#595721451651465227> or dms? Don’t know if you’re aware though; SBC is most likely being postponed until May/June. wasn't aware, thank you It was announced to be postponed to August today, I think: https://cbr.stanford.edu/sbc22/ I feel like we should be planning conferences at locations least likely to suddenly change travel/gathering rules. That is, give strong preference to locations that have a history of stability in terms of what people are allowed to do when it comes to travel and interactions. Having conferences constantly be cancelled and rescheduled because the local government decided to change the rules seems like it would discourage planning for them. (I'm making the assumption that it was rescheduled because CA is crazy) <dankrad> it may even be just Stanford in this case If it’s Stanford then Russians are out bc no visas Also hard requirement that all travelers are vaccinated w/ _approved_ vaccine <dankrad> Well SBC was to be held at Stanford and I just meant that I think it's likely that it was cancelled due to Stanford being closed, and nothing to do with regulations in CA <dankrad> I am not suggesting holding a conference at Stanford since you seem to be confused by this 👌🏻 Just saying that US in general is not the best jurisdiction for international conferences. <timbeiko> Agreed, and we definitely will avoid it for conferences “we” organize, like we did for Amphora 😄
